lal_fishmonger.text: Atún rojo, bluefin tuna, from the almadraba. That's a maze of nets the fishermen of the Cádiz coast have set in the sea since ancient times, to catch the tuna as they come through the Strait each spring.
A big one weighs more than three of me. I don't sell them whole. I'm strong, but I'm not stupid.

lal_jamon.text: Jamón ibérico, from black Iberian pigs. The best ones spend their last autumn eating acorns under the oaks. Sliced so thin you can read the paper through it.
A whole leg takes years to cure. Like a good friendship. Or a planning application.

lal_shopper.text: I shop on this side and work on that side. Bread's cheaper here, petrol's cheaper there. My whole life is a spreadsheet with a fence across it.
